15: const DEFAULT_CONTENT = './content';

17: 
18: function usage(): string {

21:     '',

24:     '  --output <dir>    Output directory (default: ./dist)',
25:     '  -h, --help        Show this help',
26:   ].join('\n');
27: }
28: 
29: function parseFlagValue(argv: string[], flag: string, index: number): string | null {
30:   const arg = argv[index];
31:   if (arg === flag) {
32:     const value = argv[index + 1];
33:     return value !== undefined ? value : null;
34:   }
35:   if (arg.startsWith(`${flag}=`)) {
36:     return arg.slice(flag.length + 1);
37:   }
38:   return null;
39: }
40: 
41: export function parseArgs(argv: string[]): ParsedCli | null {
42:   const args = argv.slice();
43:   const command = args.shift();
44:   if (command === undefined || command === '-h' || command === '--help') return null;
45:   if (command !== 'build') return null;
46: 
47:   const options: CliOptions = { content: DEFAULT_CONTENT, output: DEFAULT_OUTPUT };
48:   for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
49:     const arg = args[i];
50:     if (arg === '-h' || arg === '--help') return null;
51:     const contentValue = parseFlagValue(args, '--content', i);
52:     if (contentValue !== null) {
53:       options.content = contentValue;
54:       if (args[i] === '--content') i++;
55:       continue;
56:     }
57:     const outputValue = parseFlagValue(args, '--output', i);
58:     if (outputValue !== null) {
59:       options.output = outputValue;
60:       if (args[i] === '--output') i++;
61:       continue;
62:     }
63:     return null;
64:   }
65:   return { command, options };
66: }

part.text:
Implemented template engine and layout support.

**What was added:**
- `src/engine.ts` — `TemplateEngine`/`loadTemplates` supporting Handlebars (`.hbs`) and EJS (`.ejs`) templates, layout wrapping via `{{{body}}}`/`<%- body %>`, and partials (`{{> name }}`/`<%- include(...) %>`). Each engine uses an isolated Handlebars instance to avoid partial collisions.
- `src/page.ts` / `src/markdown.ts` — pages can now declare `template` and `layout` in frontmatter.
- `src/build.ts` — `buildSite(content, output, templatesDir?)` uses the engine when a templates dir exists, falling back to the original built-in HTML otherwise.
- `src/cli.ts` — new `--templates` flag (default `./templates`).
- Default templates at `./templates/`: `default.hbs`, `index.hbs`, `layouts/default.hbs`, and partials `header.hbs`, `footer.hbs`, `nav.hbs`.
- `tests/templates.test.ts` (10 new tests) plus updated `tests/helpers.ts` and CLI tests for the new option.

All existing functionality (built-in rendering fallback, recursive discovery, sorting, CLI) continues to work. Verified with `tsc` and full jest suite.
